title: 第13章 红绳糯米今犹在第14章 它笑了他尿了
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
回到小院，青墨就把大白扔给了柳雨柔，让她帮大白提升境界，并且在拍卖会开始前不要来打扰自己。
“宿主，在拍卖会开始前穿越别的世界搞点事呗？”
“好啊！
怎么搞”
“我选宿主的时候穿越到各个位面，能量用了太多。
你那么厉害，穿越过去帮我压制那方世界的意志，我吸收世界本源补充能量”
“嗯，可以，主要是哪种世界？”
“你以前在蓝星，看过的那些影视剧，动漫，小说里面的世界！”
“太好了！
那可是爷的青春啊！”
“要去多久啊？不会耽误这边的事吧？”
“不会，想回随时能回。”
“那开始吧”
异空间通道开启，青墨来到了一片密林，感觉这个世界的灵气已经稀薄得感觉不到它的存在一样。
突然天空乌云密布，青墨感觉有股压力施加在自己身上，是这个世界的意志，在排斥他这个外来者。
“宿主，它想把我踢出这方世界，你把它弄晕就行，这样我才能吸收世界本源。”
青墨释放了一丝丝神念，这个世界的意志承受不住，陷入休眠当中。
“系统，这是哪啊？怎么灵气那么稀薄。”
“红绳糯米今犹在，不见当年林道人”
“原来是九叔的世界，难怪灵气如此稀薄，这已经是末法时代了。”

“这是哪个时间段的九叔？，时间比例是多少？”
“一比一个月，前方小镇就是任家镇。”
“当年看九叔抓鬼除僵尸的少年们，如今都变成帅哥美女啦！
只有作者长成了憨批！”
“宿主你说啥呢？”
“没什么，咱们会对剧情有影响吗？”
“没有问题，这方时间意志没有灵智，全凭本能，我吸收了它的本源等同于它。”
“那行。”
青墨漫步走到任家镇口，看着那个时代的建筑，一抹怀旧感油然而生，他发现不远处的山坡上出现了尸气还有一些鬼气，那应该就是任老太爷的墓和小玉的墓，青墨在街上随意逛着，想试试这个时代的吃喝怎么样！
转念一想，完了。
没有这个时代的钱啊！
自己身上的灵石不能在这个时代用！
“哎呀，这个国家隔壁的岛屿日子过得不错的啊！
自家人的肯定不能拿，但是别人家的谁又看得见？”
系统都看不下去了，自己选的宿主好像就记得魏武雄风了，这点小事还要提醒！
青墨听到系统的话，嘴角浮现美好的笑容，心神一动，把隔壁岛屿的所有珍贵资源和矿产全收了，顺便来个海啸，送他们早登极乐。
“哎呀，自从无敌后第一次做好事，突然感觉自己高尚了许多！
当雷锋的感觉真好！”
content_en:
Back in the small courtyard, Qing Mo threw Dabai to Liu Yurou and asked her to help Dabai improve his realm and not to disturb him before the auction started.
"Host, why don't you travel to other worlds to do something before the auction starts?"
"Okay!
What to do?”
“When I chose a host, I traveled through various planes and used too much energy.
You are so powerful, you traveled through the past to help me suppress the will of that world, and I absorbed the origin of the world to replenish energy."
"Well, okay, what kind of world is it mainly?"
"The world in those movies, TV shows, animations, and novels you used to watch in Blue Star!"
"Great!
That was my youth! "
"How long are you going for? It won't delay things here, right?"
"No, I can go back anytime I want."
"Then let's get started"
The different space passage was opened, and Qing Mo came to a dense forest, feeling that the spiritual energy of this world was so thin that he could not feel its existence.
Suddenly the sky was covered with dark clouds, and Qing Mo felt a pressure exerted on himself. It was the will of the world that was rejecting him, an outsider.
"Host, it wants to kick me out of this world. Just knock it out so that I can absorb the origin of the world."
Qing Mo released a trace of his spiritual thoughts. The will of this world could not bear it and fell into dormancy.
"System, where is this? Why is the spiritual energy so thin?"
“The red rope glutinous rice is still there today, but I don’t see Lin Taoist from back then.”
"It turns out to be Uncle Jiu's world. No wonder the spiritual energy is so thin. This is already the end of the Dharma era."
"Which time period is Uncle Jiu in? What is the time ratio?"
"Compared with one month, the town ahead is Renjia Town."
“The teenagers who used to watch Uncle Nine catching ghosts and killing zombies have now become handsome men and beauties!
Only the author has grown up to be a fool! "
"Host, what did you say?"
"Nothing, will we have any impact on the plot?"
"No problem. This time will has no intelligence and relies entirely on instinct. I absorbed its origin and became equal to it."
"That's okay."
Qing Mo walked to the entrance of Renjia Town and looked at the buildings of that era. A sense of nostalgia arose spontaneously. He found corpse aura and some ghost aura appeared on the hillside not far away. Those should be the tombs of Mr. Ren and Xiaoyu. Qing Mo wandered around the street casually, wanting to try the food and drink of this era!
On second thought, it's over.
There is no money in this era!
The spiritual stones on your body cannot be used in this era!
“Oh, the island next to this country is doing well!
You can't take what belongs to your own family, but who can see what belongs to other people? "
The system can't stand it anymore. The host I chose seems to remember Wei Wu Xiongfeng, so I have to remind you of this little thing!
When Qing Mo heard the system's words, a beautiful smile appeared on his lips. With a thought, he collected all the precious resources and minerals on the island next door, and sent them a tsunami to send them to bliss as soon as possible.
“Oh, it’s the first time I’ve done something good since I became invincible, and I suddenly feel a lot nobler!
It feels so good to be Lei Feng! "
